description: In collapse_by_thread (email.rs:896-907), if an email id from the query result is not found in thread_map (the backend returned it from query but not from get_objects — e.g., a race or a buggy backend), the code does 'None => result.push(id)' — the email is included in the page unconditionally. This means a ghost email (one that just got deleted between query and get) passes through the collapse filter and appears in the response. The correct behavior is to omit the id (it no longer exists) or at minimum not let it bypass the seen_threads deduplication. Maintenance consequence: response can contain duplicate thread representatives or ghost ids that clients will then fail to fetch.
title: collapse_by_thread includes emails missing from thread map unconditionally
